question_en: List every TR that affected TS 38.211 and its impact type (revision history of 38.211).
cypher: MATCH (sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.211'})<-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]-(ti:TRImpact)<-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]-(tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, ti.impactType, ti.affectedSection, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY tr.trNumber
